contributor_notes: This is a documentary analyzing Hollywood's historical portrayal of LGBTQ characters (sissy characters, coded gays, cruel stereotypes, censorship under the Production Code), not a narrative title with its own queer characters, so queer_characters is left empty. The film critiques harmful tropes rather than employing them, so rep_tropes was left empty; a maintainer may wish to reconsider whether the documented stereotypes warrant tagging. Rob Epstein is described in the source as a 'gay documentarian'; sourced as self-identified-public since the exact attribution isn't given. Adapted from Vito Russo's 1981 book.
